title: Prayer, Patience, and Trust in Allah's Provision

paragraphs.text: Allah created the heavens and the earth in truth, and this is a sign for the believers. The Prophet is told to recite the Book and establish prayer, because prayer stops shameful deeds and wrongdoing, and remembering Allah is even greater. Believers should argue with the People of the Scripture only in the best way, except with those among them who do wrong. They should say that they believe in what was revealed to both groups, and that the One they all worship is the same, to whom they submit. Before the Quran, the Prophet did not read any book or write one with his hand. Otherwise, the liars would have had a reason to doubt. The Quran is preserved in the hearts of those given knowledge.

The disbelievers ask why signs are not sent to him. He is told to answer that signs are only with Allah, and he is only a clear warner. Is it not enough that the Book is recited to them? Allah is enough as a Witness. They ask him to hurry the punishment, and if a fixed time had not been set, it would already have come. It will come suddenly, covering them from above and below.

Allah tells His believing servants that His earth is wide, so they should worship only Him. Every soul will taste death and then return to Him. Those who believe and do good will live forever in high rooms in Paradise with rivers flowing beneath. This is the reward of those who are patient and rely on their Lord. Many creatures cannot carry their own food, yet Allah provides for them and for people.

hardWords.m: able to wait calmly without complaining
